# Brendon Hill Consultancy (BHC)

> A people-led hospitality consultancy in Sydney, Australia. BHC helps
> restaurants, bars, pubs, clubs and venue groups lift profit through
> strategy, operational systems, beverage programs and team development.
> Systems used across 100+ venues. Founded and led by Brendon Hill.

Documented results include a venue taken from −10% profit to a $393,600
annual turnaround, an $83,200/yr roster saving, and sustained 15%+
month-on-month beverage margin growth at a Western Sydney club resort.
